verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no auto-shutdown timer, idle termination, or spend-limit control for Pods. Prepaid credit billing, manual stop/terminate commands, and Serverless Flex workers that scale to zero are adjacent features, not a safeguard against a forgotten instance. Auto-pay works the other way, reloading the balance to avoid interruptions.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
